verdict.rationale: Aircall ships AI Assistants and AI Agents, so a buyer could fairly ask whether customer data can be excluded from AI model training. The evidence pack contains no documented training opt-out, data-usage control, or AI privacy policy. Adjacent features such as pausing call recordings or exporting recordings to your own infrastructure are different controls and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
